label: Total Current
description: Total AC current (sum or average per vendor; state which in the device map)

label: Active Power
description: Total active power; + in the meter's reference direction (POI: export)

label: Power Factor
description: Total power factor (SunSpec unit is Pct; this standard uses a -1..1 ratio)

label: Energy Exported
description: Lifetime active energy exported (delivered to grid at POI)

label: Energy Imported
description: Lifetime active energy imported (received from grid at POI)

label: Demand
description: Rolling demand over the meter's demand interval
